primary_family: Upper-tail R1 and R50 across all 5 cells x 5 quantizations: 50 BH-adjusted tests, fixed before panel results
secondary: Rinc50=R50-R1, also BH-adjusted as a separate 25-test family; k=2,5,10,20 descriptive only; original-MD overlap diagnostic
pipeline: Identical float64 observed/permuted MD, centering, MD removal, sklearn randomized PCA n_components=49 n_oversamples=20 iterated_power=7 fixed solver seed, reproject and QR
limitations: Original second-moment of pair differences is preserved by sign swaps; significant results do not establish semantic specificity. Panel choice and R1/R50 primary statistics follow the already completed single-cell recheck, so this is an extension rather than blind preregistration.
permutation_unit: independent sign per TRAIN PAIR ROW; NOT grouped by question
heldout_errors: same original float32 arithmetic (quant_plus-fp_plus-quant_minus+fp_minus), then cast float64
